verdict.rationale: llamafile's docs say models run entirely on-device with no cloud and no data sharing, and that it works fully offline. The security reference states the server sandbox blocks outbound connect(), so the server can only answer connections it received. A community user also observed it running with zero network connection. Together this means there is no usage tracking to opt out of. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that no telemetry or analytics are collected, and clarity on whether the no-outbound guarantee extends beyond the sandboxed server mode to CLI and other modes.
